caseName: Chicago, Rock Island & Pacific Railway Co. v. Kansas ex rel. Brewster
caseNameFull: Chicago, Rock Island & Pacific Railway Company, in Error v. State of Kansas ex rel. S. M. Brewster, Attorney General, etc.
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of Kansas.,
